_comment: Guard registry for scripts/prove_guards.py (`./manage.sh prove`). Each guard is neutralized in a private copy of the tree and its tests must then FAIL. Add an entry with every security guard and regression you ship; a guard whose snippet moves makes prove fail until the entry is updated.

guards.why: an edited or deleted HISTORY/REJECTED entry verifies as OK
a merge=union merge or trailing whitespace reads as tampering, so the check gets switched off

guards.find: raise MemoryLogUnsafe(f"{relpath} is linked, special, or outside the repo")
guards.why: a symlinked record file is reported as missing entries instead of as tampering
`memory_log append --type release-pass` mints the evidence shipped-green trusts

guards.find: if not head or head != expect_commit:
guards.why: a gate that ran while HEAD moved certifies a commit its checks never saw
a hand-written release-pass line with a bad hash satisfies shipped-green

guards.find: if not any(d.get("clean_start") is True for d in hits):
guards.why: tests that ran on uncommitted edits certify the commit as shipped-green

guards.replace: if False and not any(s.startswith(target) or target.startswith(s)
guards.why: reverts:/supersedes: may name a commit no HISTORY entry documents
a field smuggles a second **Outcome:** shipped-green line past the evidence check
entries after the first labelled one can silently drop the outcome
a hand-edited shipped-green with no release-pass behind it passes the gate
a checkout WITH a chain skips the shipped-green evidence check as if it had none

edits.find: env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k != "CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"}

guards.why: REDUNDANT pair (either alone suffices): the record lands in whatever repo CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR names
a release-pass is recorded under a configuration the repository no longer has
a sandbox probe that failed for any reason scores as containment

guards.find:
if ctl.returncode != 0:
        return True, f"skipped: sandbox backend present but cannot execute code
guards.replace:
if False:
        return True, f"skipped: sandbox backend present but cannot execute code
guards.why: a backend that cannot run code at all is scored instead of reported

guards.replace: raw = INTENT_MD.read_text() if INTENT_MD.exists() else None
guards.why: a symlinked INTENT.md injects an outside file into every session's context
under budget pressure the NEWEST history entry is the one dropped
the whole Knowledge narrative spends the lesson budget
a stale .pyc runs the wrong code under a mutation, crediting a failure to the wrong guard

guards.find: if rc == 1 and ("failed" in out or "FAILED" in out):
guards.why: a neutralization that breaks the import (tests never ran) is counted as proof

guards.find:
rc, out = run_tests(copy, nodes)
        if rc != 0:
guards.why: a typo'd node id or an already-failing test counts as proof of a guard
prove mutates the live tree, so an interrupted run leaves a guard neutralized in place
a lesson appended to the working tree, never committed, reaches every session's context

guards.find: if not isinstance(ev.get("test"), str) or not evidence_exists(ROOT, ev["test"]):
guards.why: a lesson whose proof was deleted is still presented as established

guards.find:
if not isinstance(d, dict) or d.get("status") not in ("test", "gate") \
                or d.get("superseded_by") is not None:
guards.why: prose-only and superseded lessons are injected as if they held

guards.find: elif not isinstance(test, str) or not evidence_exists(root, test):
guards.why: deleting a lesson's test leaves the lesson standing as a belief nobody re-checks

guards.find: return " OR ".join(f'"{t}"' for t in terms if t)
guards.why: raw user text reaches the FTS5 query grammar (column filters, NEAR, syntax errors)
a symlinked knowledge doc prints an outside file into the agent's context

guards.find: return safe == _STRIPPED_HISTORY or "[instruction-line stripped]" in safe
guards.why: an instruction-shaped lesson reaches context as a placeholder line
